title: RocketORE
description: This mod adds new "rocket" ores tools and armor. Its my first mod so i hope you enjoy ;)
body:
# RocketORE
### Is a mod that adds: 
>- New 2 Ores (Deepslate RocketOre and RocketOre),
>- New Items like Raw Rocket Ingot and Rocket Ingot, 
>- New armor: Rocket helmet, Rocket Chestplate, Rocket leggins, Rocket Boots, 
>- New Tools: Rocket Sword, Rocket Pickaxe, Rocket Axe, Rocket Shovel and Rocket Hoe

*if anyone finds a bug please report it at my discord server*
